💛 Setembro Amarelo 2026

Valorização da Vida · Prevenção ao Suicídio

O Setembro Amarelo é a campanha de conscientização sobre a prevenção do suicídio. Falar sobre o assunto salva vidas. O Dia Mundial de Prevenção ao Suicídio é celebrado em 10 de setembro.

  • Saúde mental importa: procure ajuda ao primeiro sinal de sofrimento
  • Converse, acolha e escute sem julgar — você pode salvar uma vida
  • O CVV (Centro de Valorização da Vida) atende gratuitamente, 24h por dia
  • Em caso de emergência, procure o CAPS ou uma unidade de saúde

Você não está sozinho(a). Se precisar conversar, ligue 188 (CVV) — ligação gratuita, sigilosa e disponível 24 horas.

<main>
    




    .hero-aniversario-home {
        background: url('public/images/fundo159anos.jpeg') center center / cover no-repeat;
        color: #fff;
        padding: 48px 0 40px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-align: center;
    }
    .hero-aniversario-home::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background: rgba(0, 30, 10, 0.45);
        pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-ano {
        font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
        font-size: clamp(4rem, 12vw, 7rem);
        font-weight: 800;
        line-height: 1;
        color: #FFCC00;
        text-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(255,204,0,0.35);
        display: block;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
    }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-titulo {
        font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
        font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 3vw, 1.7rem);
        font-weight: 600;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #fff;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        margin: 0 0 6px;
    }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-data {
        font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
        font-size: 1rem;
        color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
        margin-bottom: 24px;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
    }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-divider {
        width: 80px;
        height: 3px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #FFCC00, transparent);
        margin: 0 auto 20px;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
    }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-cta {
        display: inline-block;
        background: #FFCC00;
        color: #004d13;
        font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        padding: 12px 32px;
        border-radius: 30px;
        text-decoration: none;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255,204,0,0.4);
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-cta:hover {
        background: #fff;
        color: #006218;
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(255,204,0,0.5);
        text-decoration: none;
    }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-particles {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 0;
    }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-particles span {
        position: absolute;
        width: 6px;
        height: 6px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: rgba(255,204,0,0.3);
        animation: particle-float 8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-particles span:nth-child(1) { top: 20%; left: 10%; animation-delay: 0s; }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-particles span:nth-child(2) { top: 60%; left: 20%; animation-delay: -2s; width:4px;height:4px; }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-particles span:nth-child(3) { top: 30%; right: 15%; animation-delay: -4s; }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-particles span:nth-child(4) { bottom: 25%; right: 25%; animation-delay: -1s; width:8px;height:8px; }
    .hero-aniversario-home .hero-particles span:nth-child(5) { top: 70%; right: 10%; animation-delay: -3s; width:5px;height:5px; }
    @keyframes particle-float {
        0%,100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity: 0.3; }
        50% { transform: translateY(-20px) scale(1.3); opacity: 0.7; }
    }













    
        
            

                
                
                    .live-banner {
                        position: relative;
                        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00280e 0%, #005a1e 60%, #007a2a 100%);
                        border-radius: 12px;
                        overflow: hidden;
                        box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 40, 14, 0.35);
                        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
                        color: #fff;
                    }
                    .live-banner::before {
                        content: '';
                        position: absolute;
                        inset: 0;
                        background: radial-gradient(circle at 85% 20%, rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.15) 0%, transparent 45%);
                        pointer-events: none;
                    }
                    .live-banner .live-grid {
                        display: grid;
                        grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr;
                        gap: 1.5rem;
                        align-items: center;
                        padding: 1.5rem;
                        position: relative;
                        z-index: 1;
                    }
                    @media (max-width: 767px) {
                        .live-banner .live-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
                    }
                    .live-badge {
                        display: inline-flex;
                        align-items: center;
                        gap: 0.5rem;
                        background: #e8112d;
                        color: #fff;
                        font-weight: 800;
                        font-size: 0.8rem;
                        letter-spacing: 0.12em;
                        text-transform: uppercase;
                        padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem;
                        border-radius: 30px;
                        box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(232, 17, 45, 0.5);
                        margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
                    }
                    .live-badge .live-dot {
                        width: 10px;
                        height: 10px;
                        border-radius: 50%;
                        background: #fff;
                        animation: live-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
                    }
                    @keyframes live-pulse {
                        0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
                        50% { transform: scale(1.5); opacity: 0.5; }
                    }
                    .live-banner h2 {
                        font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
                        font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 1.8rem);
                        font-weight: 700;
                        color: #fff;
                        margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
                        line-height: 1.25;
                    }
                    .live-banner .live-desc {
                        font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
                        font-size: 0.95rem;
                        color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
                        margin: 0 0 1rem;
                    }
                    .live-banner .live-cta {
                        display: inline-flex;
                        align-items: center;
                        gap: 0.5rem;
                        background: #FFCC00;
                        color: #004d13;
                        font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
                        font-weight: 700;
                        font-size: 0.9rem;
                        padding: 0.7rem 1.4rem;
                        border-radius: 30px;
                        text-decoration: none;
                        transition: all 0.3s ease;
                        box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(255,204,0,0.4);
                    }
                    .live-banner .live-cta:hover {
                        background: #fff;
                        transform: translateY(-2px);
                        text-decoration: none;
                        color: #006218;
                    }
                    .live-video {
                        position: relative;
                        width: 100%;
                        border-radius: 10px;
                        overflow: hidden;
                        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
                        background: #000;
                    }
                    .live-video iframe {
                        display: block;
                        width: 100%;

                        /* ===== VARIÁVEIS CSS MODERNAS ===== */
                        :root {
                            --primary-color: #006218;
                            --primary-dark: #004d13;
                            --primary-light: #e6f3e7;
                            --accent-color: #FFCC00;
                            --text-dark: #2d3748;
                            --text-light: #4a5568;
                            --text-muted: #718096;
                            --bg-white: #ffffff;
                            --bg-light: #f8f9fa;
                            --shadow-sm: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
                            --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
                            --shadow-lg: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
                            --shadow-xl: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 98, 24, 0.15);
                            --border-radius: 12px;
                            --border-radius-sm: 8px;
                            --border-radius-lg: 16px;
                            --transition: all 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS GERAIS ===== */
                        .bck-white1 {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-light) 0%, var(--bg-white) 100%);
                        }

                        /* ===== CARDS MODERNOS ===== */
                        .card {
                            border: none;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            overflow: hidden;
                            background: var(--bg-white);
                        }

                        .card:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-4px);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        .card-body {
                            padding: 1.5rem;
                        }

                        /* ===== CARROSSEL PRINCIPAL ===== */
                        #carouselExampleFade {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            overflow: hidden;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        .carousel-caption {
                            background: linear-gradient(to top,
                                    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) 0%,
                                    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) 60%,
                                    transparent 100%);
                            padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius) var(--border-radius) 0 0;
                            left: 0;
                            right: 0;
                            bottom: 0;
                            text-align: left;
                        }

                        .carousel-caption .card-text {
                            color: var(--accent-color);
                            font-size: 0.9rem;
                            font-weight: 600;
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 1px;
                            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
                            text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
                        }

                        .carousel-caption .card-title {
                            color: #ffffff;
                            font-size: 1.5rem;
                            font-weight: 700;
                            line-height: 1.3;
                            margin-bottom: 0;
                            text-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
                            text-transform: none;
                            letter-spacing: normal;
                        }

                        .carousel-caption a {
                            text-decoration: none;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .carousel-caption a:hover .card-title {
                            color: var(--accent-color);
                            transform: translateX(5px);
                        }

                        .carousel-control-prev,
                        .carousel-control-next {
                            width: 5%;
                            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
                            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .carousel-control-prev:hover,
                        .carousel-control-next:hover {
                            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
                        }

                        /* ===== BANNER ROTATIVO MELHORADO ===== */
                        .banner-rotativo {
                            position: relative;
                            overflow: hidden;
                            height: 410px;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        .banner-item {
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 0;
                            left: 0;
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 100%;
                            opacity: 0;
                            transition: opacity 1.2s ease-in-out;
                            z-index: 1;
                            pointer-events: none;
                        }

                        .banner-item.active {
                            z-index: 10;
                            pointer-events: auto;
                        }

                        .banner-item img {
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 100%;
                            object-fit: cover;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
                        }

                        .banner-item:hover img {
                            transform: scale(1.02);
                        }

                        .banner-item a {
                            display: block;
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 100%;
                        }

                        /* ===== INDICADORES MODERNOS ===== */
                        .banner-indicators {
                            position: absolute;
                            bottom: 20px;
                            left: 50%;
                            transform: translateX(-50%);
                            display: flex;
                            gap: 12px;
                            z-index: 20;
                            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
                            backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
                            padding: 8px 16px;
                            border-radius: 25px;
                        }

                        .indicator {
                            width: 10px;
                            height: 10px;
                            border-radius: 50%;
                            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
                            cursor: pointer;
                            transition: all 0.4s ease;
                            border: 2px solid transparent;
                        }

                        .indicator:hover,
                        .indicator.active {
                            background: var(--accent-color);
                            transform: scale(1.3);
                            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.4);
                            border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
                        }

                        /* ===== TIPOGRAFIA MELHORADA ===== */
                        h1 {
                            font-weight: 700;
                            font-size: 2.5rem;
                            line-height: 1.2;
                            color: var(--text-dark);
                            margin-bottom: 2rem;
                        }

                        h5.card-title {
                            font-weight: 600;
                            color: var(--primary-color);
                            line-height: 1.4;
                            font-size: 0.95rem;
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
                        }

                        .card-text {
                            color: var(--text-light);
                            line-height: 1.6;
                            margin-bottom: 0;
                        }

                        /* ===== SISTEMA DE FILTROS MODERNIZADO ===== */
                        .shuffle-btn-group {
                            margin-bottom: 3rem;
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group label {
                            background: var(--bg-white);
                            border: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
                            border-radius: 25px;
                            padding: 12px 24px;
                            margin: 6px;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            cursor: pointer;
                            font-weight: 500;
                            color: var(--text-light);
                            display: inline-block;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group label:hover {
                            border-color: var(--primary-color);
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                            color: var(--primary-color);
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group label.active {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color) 0%, var(--primary-dark) 100%);
                            color: white;
                            border-color: var(--primary-color);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group input[type="radio"] {
                            display: none;
                        }

                        /* ===== CARDS DE SERVIÇOS COLORIDOS ===== */
                        .shuffle-wrapper {
                            display: flex;
                            flex-wrap: wrap;
                            align-items: stretch;
                        }

                        .shuffle-item {
                            display: flex;
                            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            border: 2px solid transparent;
                            padding: 1.5rem 1rem;
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8f9fa 0%, #ffffff 100%);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
                            position: relative;
                            overflow: hidden;
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 140px;
                            display: flex;
                            flex-direction: column;
                            justify-content: space-between;
                            align-items: center;
                            min-height: 140px;
                            max-height: 140px;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone .icon-box {
                            flex: 1;
                            display: flex;
                            align-items: center;
                            justify-content: center;
                            padding: 0.5rem 0;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone .topic-title {
                            flex-shrink: 0;
                            width: 100%;
                            text-align: center;
                            padding: 0 0.5rem;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone .topic-title h6 {
                            font-size: 0.8rem;
                            line-height: 1.3;
                            margin: 0;
                            display: -webkit-box;
                            /* -webkit-line-clamp: 2; */
                            line-clamp: 2;
                            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
                            overflow: hidden;
                            text-overflow: ellipsis;
                            min-height: 2rem;
                        }

                        /* Sistema de cores baseadas no layout institucional */
                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(1) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e6f3e7 0%, #c8e6c9 100%);
                            border-color: #006218;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(2) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff8e1 0%, #ffecb3 100%);
                            border-color: #FFCC00;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(3) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f1f8e9 0%, #dcedc8 100%);
                            border-color: #4caf50;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(4) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff3e0 0%, #ffe0b2 100%);
                            border-color: #ff9800;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(5) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e8 0%, #c8e6c9 100%);
                            border-color: #2e7d32;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(6) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fffde7 0%, #fff9c4 100%);
                            border-color: #f57f17;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(7) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e0f2f1 0%, #b2dfdb 100%);
                            border-color: #00695c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(8) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e6f3e7 0%, #a5d6a7 100%);
                            border-color: #388e3c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(9) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff8e1 0%, #ffcc02 100%);
                            border-color: #f9a825;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(10) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3e5f5 0%, #ce93d8 100%);
                            border-color: #7b1fa2;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(11) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e8 0%, #81c784 100%);
                            border-color: #43a047;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(12) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff9c4 0%, #f0f4c3 100%);
                            border-color: #9e9d24;
                        }

                        /* Efeito hover com cores mais vibrantes */
                        .bordaIcone::before {
                            content: '';
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 0;
                            left: 0;
                            right: 0;
                            bottom: 0;
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 100%);
                            opacity: 0;
                            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.02);
                            box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
                            border-width: 3px;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover::before {
                            opacity: 1;
                        }

                        /* Cores específicas para os ícones no hover - baseadas no layout */
                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(1):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #006218;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(2):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #FFCC00;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(3):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #4caf50;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(4):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #ff9800;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(5):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #2e7d32;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(6):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #f57f17;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(7):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #00695c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(8):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #388e3c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(9):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #f9a825;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(10):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #7b1fa2;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(11):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #43a047;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(12):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #9e9d24;
                        }

                        .topic-icon {
                            position: relative;
                            z-index: 2;
                            transition: all 0.4s ease;
                        }

                        .topic-icon svg {
                            transition: all 0.4s ease;
                            filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1));
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover .topic-icon svg {
                            transform: scale(1.2) rotate(8deg);
                            filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2));
                        }

                        /* Efeito de brilho nos cards */
                        .bordaIcone::after {
                            content: '';
                            position: absolute;
                            top: -50%;
                            left: -50%;
                            width: 200%;
                            height: 200%;
                            background: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 50%, transparent 70%);
                            transform: rotate(35deg);
                            transition: all 0.6s ease;
                            opacity: 0;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover::after {
                            animation: shine 0.8s ease-out;
                        }

                        @keyframes shine {
                            0% {
                                opacity: 0;
                                transform: translateX(-100%) translateY(-100%) rotate(35deg);
                            }

                            50% {
                                opacity: 1;
                            }

                            100% {
                                opacity: 0;
                                transform: translateX(100%) translateY(100%) rotate(35deg);
                            }
                        }

                        .topic-title {
                            position: relative;
                            z-index: 2;
                            transition: all 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        .topic-title h6 {
                            font-weight: 600;
                            margin: 0;
                            transition: all 0.3s ease;
                            text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover .topic-title h6 {
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                            font-weight: 700;
                        }

                        /* ===== FLAG NOVO DISCRETA ===== */
                        .flag-novo {
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 12px;
                            /* right: 12px; */
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFCC00 0%, #f9a825 100%);
                            color: #006218;
                            /* padding: 3px 8px; */
                            border-radius: 12px;
                            font-size: 0.6rem;
                            font-weight: 600;
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                            z-index: 5;
                            box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.25);
                            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 98, 24, 0.1);
                            transition: all 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        .flag-novo:hover {
                            transform: scale(1.05);
                            box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.35);
                        }

                        /* ===== BOTÕES MELHORADOS ===== */
                        .btn-primary {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color) 0%, var(--primary-dark) 100%);
                            border: none;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius-sm);
                            font-weight: 600;
                            padding: 14px 28px;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                        }

                        .btn-primary:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 98, 24, 0.3);
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-dark) 0%, var(--primary-color) 100%);
                        }

                        /* ===== CARDS DE NOTÍCIAS APRIMORADOS ===== */
                        .card img {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius) var(--border-radius) 0 0;
                            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
                        }

                        .card:hover img {
                            transform: scale(1.05);
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS NOS VÍDEOS ===== */
                        .video-thumbnail {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            overflow: hidden;
                            position: relative;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .video-thumbnail::before {
                            content: '';
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 0;
                            left: 0;
                            right: 0;
                            bottom: 0;
                            background: linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3));
                            opacity: 0;
                            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
                            z-index: 1;
                        }

                        .video-thumbnail:hover::before {
                            opacity: 1;
                        }

                        .video-thumbnail:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        /* ===== RESPONSIVIDADE APRIMORADA ===== */
                        @media (max-width: 768px) {
                            .banner-rotativo {
                                height: 280px;
                            }

                            h1 {
                                font-size: 2rem;
                            }

                            .shuffle-btn-group label {
                                padding: 10px 20px;
                                margin: 4px;
                                font-size: 0.9rem;
                            }

                            .card-body {
                                padding: 1.25rem;
                            }

                            /* Cards de serviços em tablet */
                            .bordaIcone {
                                height: 120px;
                                min-height: 120px;
                                max-height: 120px;
                                padding: 1.25rem 0.75rem;
                            }

                            .bordaIcone .topic-title h6 {
                                font-size: 0.75rem;
                                min-height: 1.8rem;
                            }

                            /* Melhorias no carrossel para mobile */
                            .carousel-caption {
                                padding: 1.5rem 1rem;
                            }

                            .carousel-caption .card-title {
                                font-size: 1.25rem;
                            }

                            .carousel-caption .card-text {
                                font-size: 0.8rem;
                            }
                        }

                        @media (max-width: 576px) {
                            .banner-rotativo {
                                height: 220px;
                            }

                            .banner-indicators {
                                bottom: 15px;
                                padding: 6px 12px;
                            }

                            .indicator {
                                width: 8px;
                                height: 8px;
                            }

                            h1 {
                                font-size: 1.75rem;
                            }

                            /* Cards de serviços em mobile */
                            .bordaIcone {
                                height: 110px;
                                min-height: 110px;
                                max-height: 110px;
                                padding: 1rem 0.5rem;
                            }

                            .bordaIcone .topic-icon svg {
                                width: 30px;
                                height: 30px;
                            }

                            .bordaIcone .topic-title h6 {
                                font-size: 0.7rem;
                                min-height: 1.6rem;
                                line-height: 1.2;
                            }

                            /* Carrossel mobile extra pequeno */
                            .carousel-caption {
                                padding: 1rem 0.75rem;
                            }

                            .carousel-caption .card-title {
                                font-size: 1.1rem;
                                line-height: 1.4;
                            }

                            .carousel-caption .card-text {
                                font-size: 0.75rem;
                                margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
                            }
                        }

                        /* ===== ANIMAÇÕES SUTIS ===== */
                        @keyframes fadeInUp {
                            from {
                                opacity: 0;
                                transform: translateY(20px);
                            }

                            to {
                                opacity: 1;
                                transform: translateY(0);
                            }
                        }

                        .card,
                        .bordaIcone {
                            animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease forwards;
                        }

                        .card:nth-child(even) {
                            animation-delay: 0.1s;
                        }

                        .card:nth-child(odd) {
                            animation-delay: 0.2s;
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS NO CARROSSEL DE VÍDEOS ===== */
                        .carousel-control-prev,
                        .carousel-control-next {
                            background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--primary-color), var(--secondary-color));
                            border: none;
                            width: 45px;
                            height: 45px;
                            border-radius: 50%;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                        }

                        .carousel-control-prev:hover,
                        .carousel-control-next:hover {
                            transform: scale(1.1);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        .carousel-indicators button {
                            width: 12px;
                            height: 12px;
                            border-radius: 50%;
                            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
                            margin: 0 4px;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .carousel-indicators button.active {
                            background: var(--primary-color);
                            transform: scale(1.2);
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS EM VÍDEOS EMBEDADOS ===== */
                        .embed-responsive {
                            border-radius: 12px;
                            overflow: hidden;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .embed-responsive:hover {

    // Banner Rotativo - Versão Ultra Simples com Debug
    let currentBanner = 0;
    let totalBanners = 3; // Corrigido: são 3 banners, não 2
    let autoRotate;

    // Função para mostrar um banner específico
    function showBanner(index) {
        // Esconde todos os banners e ajusta z-index
        for (let i = 0; i < totalBanners; i++) {
            const banner = document.getElementById('banner-' + i);
            const indicator = document.getElementById('indicator-' + i);

            if (banner) {
                banner.style.opacity = '0';
                banner.style.zIndex = '1'; // z-index baixo para banners inativos
                banner.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; // Desabilita cliques em banners inativos
            }
            if (indicator) indicator.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)';
        }

        // Mostra o banner selecionado
        const selectedBanner = document.getElementById('banner-' + index);
        const selectedIndicator = document.getElementById('indicator-' + index);

        if (selectedBanner) {
            selectedBanner.style.opacity = '1';
            selectedBanner.style.zIndex = '10'; // z-index alto para banner ativo
            selectedBanner.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; // Habilita cliques no banner ativo
        }
        if (selectedIndicator) selectedIndicator.style.background = '#FFCC00';

        currentBanner = index;
    }

    // Função para próximo banner (rotação automática)
    function nextBanner() {
        const nextIndex = (currentBanner + 1) % totalBanners;
        showBanner(nextIndex);
    }

    // Função para embaralhar e começar
    function startBannerRotation() {
        // Escolhe um banner aleatório para começar
        const randomStart = Math.floor(Math.random() * totalBanners);
        showBanner(randomStart);

        // Inicia rotação automática
        autoRotate = setInterval(nextBanner, 3000); // 3 segundos
    }

    // Pausar rotação no hover
    function pauseRotation() {
        if (autoRotate) {
            clearInterval(autoRotate);
            autoRotate = null;
        }
    }

    // Retomar rotação
    function resumeRotation() {
        if (!autoRotate) {
            autoRotate = setInterval(nextBanner, 3000);
        }
    }

    // Inicializar quando a página carregar
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const container = document.getElementById('bannerRotativo');

        if (container) {
            // Configuração inicial de z-index e pointer-events
            for (let i = 0; i < totalBanners; i++) {
                const banner = document.getElementById('banner-' + i);
                if (banner) {
                    banner.style.zIndex = '1';
                    banner.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                }
            }

            // Adicionar eventos de hover
            container.addEventListener('mouseenter', pauseRotation);
            container.addEventListener('mouseleave', resumeRotation);

            // Começar rotação
            startBannerRotation();
        }
    });
