                        /* ===== VARIÁVEIS CSS MODERNAS ===== */
                        :root {
                            --primary-color: #006218;
                            --primary-dark: #004d13;
                            --primary-light: #e6f3e7;
                            --accent-color: #FFCC00;
                            --text-dark: #2d3748;
                            --text-light: #4a5568;
                            --text-muted: #718096;
                            --bg-white: #ffffff;
                            --bg-light: #f8f9fa;
                            --shadow-sm: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
                            --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
                            --shadow-lg: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
                            --shadow-xl: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 98, 24, 0.15);
                            --border-radius: 12px;
                            --border-radius-sm: 8px;
                            --border-radius-lg: 16px;
                            --transition: all 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS GERAIS ===== */
                        .bck-white1 {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-light) 0%, var(--bg-white) 100%);
                        }

                        /* ===== CARDS MODERNOS ===== */
                        .card {
                            border: none;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            overflow: hidden;
                            background: var(--bg-white);
                        }

                        .card:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-4px);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        .card-body {
                            padding: 1.5rem;
                        }

                        /* ===== CARROSSEL PRINCIPAL ===== */
                        #carouselExampleFade {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            overflow: hidden;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        .carousel-caption {
                            background: linear-gradient(to top,
                                    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) 0%,
                                    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) 60%,
                                    transparent 100%);
                            padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius) var(--border-radius) 0 0;
                            left: 0;
                            right: 0;
                            bottom: 0;
                            text-align: left;
                        }

                        .carousel-caption .card-text {
                            color: var(--accent-color);
                            font-size: 0.9rem;
                            font-weight: 600;
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 1px;
                            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
                            text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
                        }

                        .carousel-caption .card-title {
                            color: #ffffff;
                            font-size: 1.5rem;
                            font-weight: 700;
                            line-height: 1.3;
                            margin-bottom: 0;
                            text-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
                            text-transform: none;
                            letter-spacing: normal;
                        }

                        .carousel-caption a {
                            text-decoration: none;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .carousel-caption a:hover .card-title {
                            color: var(--accent-color);
                            transform: translateX(5px);
                        }

                        .carousel-control-prev,
                        .carousel-control-next {
                            width: 5%;
                            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
                            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .carousel-control-prev:hover,
                        .carousel-control-next:hover {
                            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
                        }

                        /* ===== BANNER ROTATIVO MELHORADO ===== */
                        .banner-rotativo {
                            position: relative;
                            overflow: hidden;
                            height: 410px;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        .banner-item {
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 0;
                            left: 0;
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 100%;
                            opacity: 0;
                            transition: opacity 1.2s ease-in-out;
                            z-index: 1;
                            pointer-events: none;
                        }

                        .banner-item.active {
                            z-index: 10;
                            pointer-events: auto;
                        }

                        .banner-item img {
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 100%;
                            object-fit: cover;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
                        }

                        .banner-item:hover img {
                            transform: scale(1.02);
                        }

                        .banner-item a {
                            display: block;
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 100%;
                        }

                        /* ===== INDICADORES MODERNOS ===== */
                        .banner-indicators {
                            position: absolute;
                            bottom: 20px;
                            left: 50%;
                            transform: translateX(-50%);
                            display: flex;
                            gap: 12px;
                            z-index: 20;
                            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
                            backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
                            padding: 8px 16px;
                            border-radius: 25px;
                        }

                        .indicator {
                            width: 10px;
                            height: 10px;
                            border-radius: 50%;
                            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
                            cursor: pointer;
                            transition: all 0.4s ease;
                            border: 2px solid transparent;
                        }

                        .indicator:hover,
                        .indicator.active {
                            background: var(--accent-color);
                            transform: scale(1.3);
                            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.4);
                            border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
                        }

                        /* ===== TIPOGRAFIA MELHORADA ===== */
                        h1 {
                            font-weight: 700;
                            font-size: 2.5rem;
                            line-height: 1.2;
                            color: var(--text-dark);
                            margin-bottom: 2rem;
                        }

                        h5.card-title {
                            font-weight: 600;
                            color: var(--primary-color);
                            line-height: 1.4;
                            font-size: 0.95rem;
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
                        }

                        .card-text {
                            color: var(--text-light);
                            line-height: 1.6;
                            margin-bottom: 0;
                        }

                        /* ===== SISTEMA DE FILTROS MODERNIZADO ===== */
                        .shuffle-btn-group {
                            margin-bottom: 3rem;
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group label {
                            background: var(--bg-white);
                            border: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
                            border-radius: 25px;
                            padding: 12px 24px;
                            margin: 6px;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            cursor: pointer;
                            font-weight: 500;
                            color: var(--text-light);
                            display: inline-block;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group label:hover {
                            border-color: var(--primary-color);
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                            color: var(--primary-color);
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group label.active {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color) 0%, var(--primary-dark) 100%);
                            color: white;
                            border-color: var(--primary-color);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group input[type="radio"] {
                            display: none;
                        }

                        /* ===== CARDS DE SERVIÇOS COLORIDOS ===== */
                        .shuffle-wrapper {
                            display: flex;
                            flex-wrap: wrap;
                            align-items: stretch;
                        }

                        .shuffle-item {
                            display: flex;
                            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            border: 2px solid transparent;
                            padding: 1.5rem 1rem;
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8f9fa 0%, #ffffff 100%);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
                            position: relative;
                            overflow: hidden;
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 140px;
                            display: flex;
                            flex-direction: column;
                            justify-content: space-between;
                            align-items: center;
                            min-height: 140px;
                            max-height: 140px;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone .icon-box {
                            flex: 1;
                            display: flex;
                            align-items: center;
                            justify-content: center;
                            padding: 0.5rem 0;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone .topic-title {
                            flex-shrink: 0;
                            width: 100%;
                            text-align: center;
                            padding: 0 0.5rem;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone .topic-title h6 {
                            font-size: 0.8rem;
                            line-height: 1.3;
                            margin: 0;
                            display: -webkit-box;
                            /* -webkit-line-clamp: 2; */
                            line-clamp: 2;
                            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
                            overflow: hidden;
                            text-overflow: ellipsis;
                            min-height: 2rem;
                        }

                        /* Sistema de cores baseadas no layout institucional */
                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(1) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e6f3e7 0%, #c8e6c9 100%);
                            border-color: #006218;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(2) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff8e1 0%, #ffecb3 100%);
                            border-color: #FFCC00;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(3) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f1f8e9 0%, #dcedc8 100%);
                            border-color: #4caf50;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(4) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff3e0 0%, #ffe0b2 100%);
                            border-color: #ff9800;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(5) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e8 0%, #c8e6c9 100%);
                            border-color: #2e7d32;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(6) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fffde7 0%, #fff9c4 100%);
                            border-color: #f57f17;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(7) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e0f2f1 0%, #b2dfdb 100%);
                            border-color: #00695c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(8) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e6f3e7 0%, #a5d6a7 100%);
                            border-color: #388e3c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(9) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff8e1 0%, #ffcc02 100%);
                            border-color: #f9a825;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(10) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3e5f5 0%, #ce93d8 100%);
                            border-color: #7b1fa2;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(11) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e8 0%, #81c784 100%);
                            border-color: #43a047;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(12) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff9c4 0%, #f0f4c3 100%);
                            border-color: #9e9d24;
                        }

                        /* Efeito hover com cores mais vibrantes */
                        .bordaIcone::before {
                            content: '';
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 0;
                            left: 0;
                            right: 0;
                            bottom: 0;
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 100%);
                            opacity: 0;
                            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.02);
                            box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
                            border-width: 3px;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover::before {
                            opacity: 1;
                        }

                        /* Cores específicas para os ícones no hover - baseadas no layout */
                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(1):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #006218;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(2):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #FFCC00;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(3):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #4caf50;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(4):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #ff9800;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(5):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #2e7d32;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(6):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #f57f17;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(7):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #00695c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(8):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #388e3c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(9):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #f9a825;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(10):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #7b1fa2;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(11):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #43a047;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(12):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #9e9d24;
                        }

                        .topic-icon {
                            position: relative;
                            z-index: 2;
                            transition: all 0.4s ease;
                        }

                        .topic-icon svg {
                            transition: all 0.4s ease;
                            filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1));
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover .topic-icon svg {
                            transform: scale(1.2) rotate(8deg);
                            filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2));
                        }

                        /* Efeito de brilho nos cards */
                        .bordaIcone::after {
                            content: '';
                            position: absolute;
                            top: -50%;
                            left: -50%;
                            width: 200%;
                            height: 200%;
                            background: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 50%, transparent 70%);
                            transform: rotate(35deg);
                            transition: all 0.6s ease;
                            opacity: 0;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover::after {
                            animation: shine 0.8s ease-out;
                        }

                        @keyframes shine {
                            0% {
                                opacity: 0;
                                transform: translateX(-100%) translateY(-100%) rotate(35deg);
                            }

                            50% {
                                opacity: 1;
                            }

                            100% {
                                opacity: 0;
                                transform: translateX(100%) translateY(100%) rotate(35deg);
                            }
                        }

                        .topic-title {
                            position: relative;
                            z-index: 2;
                            transition: all 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        .topic-title h6 {
                            font-weight: 600;
                            margin: 0;
                            transition: all 0.3s ease;
                            text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover .topic-title h6 {
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                            font-weight: 700;
                        }

                        /* ===== FLAG NOVO DISCRETA ===== */
                        .flag-novo {
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 12px;
                            /* right: 12px; */
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFCC00 0%, #f9a825 100%);
                            color: #006218;
                            /* padding: 3px 8px; */
                            border-radius: 12px;
                            font-size: 0.6rem;
                            font-weight: 600;
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                            z-index: 5;
                            box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.25);
                            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 98, 24, 0.1);
                            transition: all 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        .flag-novo:hover {
                            transform: scale(1.05);
                            box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.35);
                        }

                        /* ===== BOTÕES MELHORADOS ===== */
                        .btn-primary {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color) 0%, var(--primary-dark) 100%);
                            border: none;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius-sm);
                            font-weight: 600;
                            padding: 14px 28px;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                        }

                        .btn-primary:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 98, 24, 0.3);
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-dark) 0%, var(--primary-color) 100%);
                        }

                        /* ===== CARDS DE NOTÍCIAS APRIMORADOS ===== */
                        .card img {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius) var(--border-radius) 0 0;
                            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
                        }

                        .card:hover img {
                            transform: scale(1.05);
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS NOS VÍDEOS ===== */
                        .video-thumbnail {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            overflow: hidden;
                            position: relative;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .video-thumbnail::before {
                            content: '';
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 0;
                            left: 0;
                            right: 0;
                            bottom: 0;
                            background: linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3));
                            opacity: 0;
                            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
                            z-index: 1;
                        }

                        .video-thumbnail:hover::before {
                            opacity: 1;
                        }

                        .video-thumbnail:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        /* ===== RESPONSIVIDADE APRIMORADA ===== */
                        @media (max-width: 768px) {
                            .banner-rotativo {
                                height: 280px;
                            }

                            h1 {
                                font-size: 2rem;
                            }

                            .shuffle-btn-group label {
                                padding: 10px 20px;
                                margin: 4px;
                                font-size: 0.9rem;
                            }

                            .card-body {
                                padding: 1.25rem;
                            }

                            /* Cards de serviços em tablet */
                            .bordaIcone {
                                height: 120px;
                                min-height: 120px;
                                max-height: 120px;
                                padding: 1.25rem 0.75rem;
                            }

                            .bordaIcone .topic-title h6 {
                                font-size: 0.75rem;
                                min-height: 1.8rem;
                            }

                            /* Melhorias no carrossel para mobile */
                            .carousel-caption {
                                padding: 1.5rem 1rem;
                            }

                            .carousel-caption .card-title {
                                font-size: 1.25rem;
                            }

                            .carousel-caption .card-text {
                                font-size: 0.8rem;
                            }
                        }

                        @media (max-width: 576px) {
                            .banner-rotativo {
                                height: 220px;
                            }

                            .banner-indicators {
                                bottom: 15px;
                                padding: 6px 12px;
                            }

                            .indicator {
                                width: 8px;
                                height: 8px;
                            }

                            h1 {
                                font-size: 1.75rem;
                            }

                            /* Cards de serviços em mobile */
                            .bordaIcone {
                                height: 110px;
                                min-height: 110px;
                                max-height: 110px;
                                padding: 1rem 0.5rem;
                            }

                            .bordaIcone .topic-icon svg {
                                width: 30px;
                                height: 30px;
                            }

                            .bordaIcone .topic-title h6 {
                                font-size: 0.7rem;
                                min-height: 1.6rem;
                                line-height: 1.2;
                            }

                            /* Carrossel mobile extra pequeno */
                            .carousel-caption {
                                padding: 1rem 0.75rem;
                            }

                            .carousel-caption .card-title {
                                font-size: 1.1rem;
                                line-height: 1.4;
                            }

                            .carousel-caption .card-text {
                                font-size: 0.75rem;
                                margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
                            }
                        }

                        /* ===== ANIMAÇÕES SUTIS ===== */
                        @keyframes fadeInUp {
                            from {
                                opacity: 0;
                                transform: translateY(20px);
                            }

                            to {
                                opacity: 1;
                                transform: translateY(0);
                            }
                        }

                        .card,
                        .bordaIcone {
                            animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease forwards;
                        }

                        .card:nth-child(even) {
                            animation-delay: 0.1s;
                        }

                        .card:nth-child(odd) {
                            animation-delay: 0.2s;
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS NO CARROSSEL DE VÍDEOS ===== */
                        .carousel-control-prev,
                        .carousel-control-next {
                            background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--primary-color), var(--secondary-color));
                            border: none;
                            width: 45px;
                            height: 45px;
                            border-radius: 50%;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                        }

                        .carousel-control-prev:hover,
                        .carousel-control-next:hover {
                            transform: scale(1.1);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        .carousel-indicators button {
                            width: 12px;
                            height: 12px;
                            border-radius: 50%;
                            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
                            margin: 0 4px;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .carousel-indicators button.active {
                            background: var(--primary-color);
                            transform: scale(1.2);
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS EM VÍDEOS EMBEDADOS ===== */
                        .embed-responsive {
                            border-radius: 12px;
                            overflow: hidden;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .embed-responsive:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-3px);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS NO SISTEMA DE NOTÍCIAS ===== */
                        .news-card {
                            background: var(--bg-white);
                            border-radius: 12px;
                            padding: 1.5rem;
                            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            border-left: 4px solid var(--primary-color);
                        }

                        .news-card:hover {
                            transform: translateX(5px);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                        }

                        .news-date {
                            color: var(--text-light);
                            font-size: 0.85rem;
                            font-weight: 500;
                            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
                        }

                        .news-title {
                            color: var(--text-dark);
                            font-weight: 600;
                            line-height: 1.4;
                            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
                        }

                        .news-excerpt {
                            color: var(--text-light);
                            line-height: 1.6;
                            margin-bottom: 1rem;
                        }

                        .read-more-btn {
                            color: var(--primary-color);
                            font-weight: 500;
                            text-decoration: none;
                            display: inline-flex;
                            align-items: center;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .read-more-btn:hover {
                            color: var(--secondary-color);
                            transform: translateX(5px);
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS NA RESPONSIVIDADE ===== */
                        @media (max-width: 768px) {
                            .container-fluid {
                                padding: 15px;
                            }

                            h1 {
                                font-size: 2rem;
                                text-align: center;
                            }

                            .shuffle-btn-group label {
                                font-size: 0.85rem;
                                padding: 8px 16px;
                                margin: 3px;
                            }

                            .card {
                                margin-bottom: 1rem;
                            }

                            .banner-indicators {
                                bottom: 15px;
                            }

                            .indicator {
                                width: 8px;
                                height: 8px;
                                margin: 0 3px;
                            }

                            .carousel-control-prev,
                            .carousel-control-next {
                                width: 35px;
                                height: 35px;
                            }
                        }

                        @media (max-width: 576px) {
                            .shuffle-btn-group {
                                text-align: center;
                            }

                            .shuffle-btn-group label {
                                display: block;
                                margin: 5px auto;
                                max-width: 200px;
                            }

                            .carousel-indicators {
                                bottom: 10px;
                            }

                            .embed-responsive {
                                margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
                            }
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS DE ACESSIBILIDADE ===== */
                        .visually-hidden {
                            position: absolute !important;
                            width: 1px !important;
                            height: 1px !important;
                            padding: 0 !important;
                            margin: -1px !important;
                            overflow: hidden !important;
                            clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important;
                            white-space: nowrap !important;
                            border: 0 !important;
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS NO FOCO PARA NAVEGAÇÃO POR TECLADO ===== */
                        .card:focus-within,
                        .shuffle-btn-group label:focus-within,
                        .indicator:focus {
                            outline: 2px solid var(--primary-color);
                            outline-offset: 2px;
                        }

                        /* ===== SMOOTH SCROLLING ===== */
                        html {
                            scroll-behavior: smooth;
                        }

                        /* ===== LOADING SKELETON (para futura implementação) ===== */
                        .skeleton {
                            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f0f0f0 25%, #e0e0e0 50%, #f0f0f0 75%);
                            background-size: 200% 100%;
                            animation: loading 1.5s infinite;
                        }

                        @keyframes loading {
                            0% {
                                background-position: 200% 0;
                            }

                            100% {
                                background-position: -200% 0;
                            }
                        }

                        /* ===== EXTRAS PARA MELHOR APARÊNCIA GERAL ===== */
                        .btn {
                            font-weight: 500;
                            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .btn:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                        }

                        .img-fluid {
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .img-fluid:hover {
                            transform: scale(1.02);
                        }

                        /* ===== INDICADOR DE LOADING PARA BANNER ===== */
                        .banner-loading {
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 50%;
                            left: 50%;
                            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
                            width: 40px;
                            height: 40px;
                            border: 3px solid rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.3);
                            border-top: 3px solid var(--primary-color);
                            border-radius: 50%;
                            animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
                            z-index: 10;
                        }

                        @keyframes spin {
                            0% {
                                transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg);
                            }

                            100% {
                                transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg);
                            }
                        }

                    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                        const scroller = document.querySelector('.video-scroller');
                        const btnLeft = document.querySelector('.video-scroll-left');
                        const btnRight = document.querySelector('.video-scroll-right');

                        function updateScrollButtons() {
                            if (!scroller) return;
                            btnLeft.style.display = scroller.scrollLeft > 10 ? 'block' : 'none';
                            btnRight.style.display = (scroller.scrollWidth - scroller.clientWidth - scroller.scrollLeft) > 10 ? 'block' : 'none';
                        }

                        if (scroller && btnLeft && btnRight) {
                            updateScrollButtons();
                            scroller.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollButtons);

                            btnLeft.addEventListener('click', function() {
                                scroller.scrollBy({
                                    left: -260,
                                    behavior: 'smooth'
                                });
                            });
                            btnRight.addEventListener('click', function() {
                                scroller.scrollBy({
                                    left: 260,
                                    behavior: 'smooth'
                                });
                            });

                            // Mostrar botões se houver overflow
                            setTimeout(updateScrollButtons, 300);
                            window.addEventListener('resize', updateScrollButtons);
                        }

                        // Efeito hover para play overlay
                        document.querySelectorAll('.video-card').forEach(function(card) {
                            card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
                                const overlay = card.querySelector('.video-play-overlay');
                                const playBtn = card.querySelector('.play-button-container');
                                if (overlay) overlay.style.opacity = '1';
                                if (playBtn) playBtn.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                            });
                            card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
                                const overlay = card.querySelector('.video-play-overlay');
                                const playBtn = card.querySelector('.play-button-container');
                                if (overlay) overlay.style.opacity = '0';
                                if (playBtn) playBtn.style.transform = 'scale(0.8)';
                            });
                        });
                    });

                    }

                    .video-scroller::-webkit-scrollbar {
                        height: 8px;
                    }

                    .video-scroller::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
                        background: var(--primary-color);
                        border-radius: 4px;
                    }

                    .video-scroller::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
                        background: #eee;
                        border-radius: 4px;
                    }

                    .video-card {
                        transition: box-shadow 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
                    }

                    .video-card:hover {
                        transform: translateY(-5px);
                        box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
                    }

                    .video-card:hover .video-thumbnail-img {
                        transform: scale(1.05);
                    }

                    .video-card:hover .video-play-overlay {
                        opacity: 1;
                    }

                    .video-card:hover .play-button-container {
                        transform: scale(1);
                    }

                    @media (max-width: 768px) {
                        .video-card {
                            min-width: 200px !important;

                        }

                            height: 120px !important;
                        }

                        .section-title {
                            font-size: 1.8rem !important;
                        }

                            font-size: 0.9rem !important;
                        }

                        .video-card {
                            min-width: 160px !important;

                        }

                        .video-thumbnail-img {
                            height: 90px !important;
                        }
                    }

                    .video-card:hover {

                    .video-card:hover .video-thumbnail-img {

                    }

                    .video-card:hover .video-play-overlay {

                    }

                        transform: scale(1);
                    }

                        /* ===== VARIÁVEIS CSS MODERNAS ===== */
                        :root {
                            --primary-color: #006218;
                            --primary-dark: #004d13;
                            --primary-light: #e6f3e7;
                            --accent-color: #FFCC00;
                            --text-dark: #2d3748;
                            --text-light: #4a5568;
                            --text-muted: #718096;
                            --bg-white: #ffffff;
                            --bg-light: #f8f9fa;
                            --shadow-sm: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
                            --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
                            --shadow-lg: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
                            --shadow-xl: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 98, 24, 0.15);
                            --border-radius: 12px;
                            --border-radius-sm: 8px;
                            --border-radius-lg: 16px;
                            --transition: all 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS GERAIS ===== */
                        .bck-white1 {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-light) 0%, var(--bg-white) 100%);
                        }

                        /* ===== CARDS MODERNOS ===== */
                        .card {
                            border: none;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            overflow: hidden;
                            background: var(--bg-white);
                        }

                        .card:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-4px);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        .card-body {
                            padding: 1.5rem;
                        }

                        /* ===== CARROSSEL PRINCIPAL ===== */
                        #carouselExampleFade {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            overflow: hidden;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        .carousel-caption {
                            background: linear-gradient(to top,
                                    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) 0%,
                                    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) 60%,
                                    transparent 100%);
                            padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius) var(--border-radius) 0 0;
                            left: 0;
                            right: 0;
                            bottom: 0;
                            text-align: left;
                        }

                        .carousel-caption .card-text {
                            color: var(--accent-color);
                            font-size: 0.9rem;
                            font-weight: 600;
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 1px;
                            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
                            text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
                        }

                        .carousel-caption .card-title {
                            color: #ffffff;
                            font-size: 1.5rem;
                            font-weight: 700;
                            line-height: 1.3;
                            margin-bottom: 0;
                            text-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
                            text-transform: none;
                            letter-spacing: normal;
                        }

                        .carousel-caption a {
                            text-decoration: none;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .carousel-caption a:hover .card-title {
                            color: var(--accent-color);
                            transform: translateX(5px);
                        }

                        .carousel-control-prev,
                        .carousel-control-next {
                            width: 5%;
                            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
                            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .carousel-control-prev:hover,
                        .carousel-control-next:hover {
                            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
                        }

                        /* ===== BANNER ROTATIVO MELHORADO ===== */
                        .banner-rotativo {
                            position: relative;
                            overflow: hidden;
                            height: 410px;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
                        }

                        .banner-item {
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 0;
                            left: 0;
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 100%;
                            opacity: 0;
                            transition: opacity 1.2s ease-in-out;
                            z-index: 1;
                            pointer-events: none;
                        }

                        .banner-item.active {
                            z-index: 10;
                            pointer-events: auto;
                        }

                        .banner-item img {
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 100%;
                            object-fit: cover;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
                        }

                        .banner-item:hover img {
                            transform: scale(1.02);
                        }

                        .banner-item a {
                            display: block;
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 100%;
                        }

                        /* ===== INDICADORES MODERNOS ===== */
                        .banner-indicators {
                            position: absolute;
                            bottom: 20px;
                            left: 50%;
                            transform: translateX(-50%);
                            display: flex;
                            gap: 12px;
                            z-index: 20;
                            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
                            backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
                            padding: 8px 16px;
                            border-radius: 25px;
                        }

                        .indicator {
                            width: 10px;
                            height: 10px;
                            border-radius: 50%;
                            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
                            cursor: pointer;
                            transition: all 0.4s ease;
                            border: 2px solid transparent;
                        }

                        .indicator:hover,
                        .indicator.active {
                            background: var(--accent-color);
                            transform: scale(1.3);
                            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.4);
                            border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
                        }

                        /* ===== TIPOGRAFIA MELHORADA ===== */
                        h1 {
                            font-weight: 700;
                            font-size: 2.5rem;
                            line-height: 1.2;
                            color: var(--text-dark);
                            margin-bottom: 2rem;
                        }

                        h5.card-title {
                            font-weight: 600;
                            color: var(--primary-color);
                            line-height: 1.4;
                            font-size: 0.95rem;
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
                        }

                        .card-text {
                            color: var(--text-light);
                            line-height: 1.6;
                            margin-bottom: 0;
                        }

                        /* ===== SISTEMA DE FILTROS MODERNIZADO ===== */
                        .shuffle-btn-group {
                            margin-bottom: 3rem;
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group label {
                            background: var(--bg-white);
                            border: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
                            border-radius: 25px;
                            padding: 12px 24px;
                            margin: 6px;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            cursor: pointer;
                            font-weight: 500;
                            color: var(--text-light);
                            display: inline-block;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group label:hover {
                            border-color: var(--primary-color);
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                            color: var(--primary-color);
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group label.active {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color) 0%, var(--primary-dark) 100%);
                            color: white;
                            border-color: var(--primary-color);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
                        }

                        .shuffle-btn-group input[type="radio"] {
                            display: none;
                        }

                        /* ===== CARDS DE SERVIÇOS COLORIDOS ===== */
                        .shuffle-wrapper {
                            display: flex;
                            flex-wrap: wrap;
                            align-items: stretch;
                        }

                        .shuffle-item {
                            display: flex;
                            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            border: 2px solid transparent;
                            padding: 1.5rem 1rem;
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8f9fa 0%, #ffffff 100%);
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
                            position: relative;
                            overflow: hidden;
                            width: 100%;
                            height: 140px;
                            display: flex;
                            flex-direction: column;
                            justify-content: space-between;
                            align-items: center;
                            min-height: 140px;
                            max-height: 140px;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone .icon-box {
                            flex: 1;
                            display: flex;
                            align-items: center;
                            justify-content: center;
                            padding: 0.5rem 0;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone .topic-title {
                            flex-shrink: 0;
                            width: 100%;
                            text-align: center;
                            padding: 0 0.5rem;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone .topic-title h6 {
                            font-size: 0.8rem;
                            line-height: 1.3;
                            margin: 0;
                            display: -webkit-box;
                            /* -webkit-line-clamp: 2; */
                            line-clamp: 2;
                            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
                            overflow: hidden;
                            text-overflow: ellipsis;
                            min-height: 2rem;
                        }

                        /* Sistema de cores baseadas no layout institucional */
                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(1) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e6f3e7 0%, #c8e6c9 100%);
                            border-color: #006218;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(2) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff8e1 0%, #ffecb3 100%);
                            border-color: #FFCC00;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(3) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f1f8e9 0%, #dcedc8 100%);
                            border-color: #4caf50;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(4) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff3e0 0%, #ffe0b2 100%);
                            border-color: #ff9800;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(5) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e8 0%, #c8e6c9 100%);
                            border-color: #2e7d32;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(6) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fffde7 0%, #fff9c4 100%);
                            border-color: #f57f17;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(7) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e0f2f1 0%, #b2dfdb 100%);
                            border-color: #00695c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(8) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e6f3e7 0%, #a5d6a7 100%);
                            border-color: #388e3c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(9) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff8e1 0%, #ffcc02 100%);
                            border-color: #f9a825;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(10) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3e5f5 0%, #ce93d8 100%);
                            border-color: #7b1fa2;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(11) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e8 0%, #81c784 100%);
                            border-color: #43a047;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(12) {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff9c4 0%, #f0f4c3 100%);
                            border-color: #9e9d24;
                        }

                        /* Efeito hover com cores mais vibrantes */
                        .bordaIcone::before {
                            content: '';
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 0;
                            left: 0;
                            right: 0;
                            bottom: 0;
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 100%);
                            opacity: 0;
                            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.02);
                            box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
                            border-width: 3px;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover::before {
                            opacity: 1;
                        }

                        /* Cores específicas para os ícones no hover - baseadas no layout */
                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(1):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #006218;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(2):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #FFCC00;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(3):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #4caf50;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(4):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #ff9800;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(5):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #2e7d32;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(6):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #f57f17;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(7):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #00695c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(8):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #388e3c;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(9):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #f9a825;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(10):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #7b1fa2;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(11):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #43a047;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:nth-child(12):hover .topic-icon svg {
                            color: #9e9d24;
                        }

                        .topic-icon {
                            position: relative;
                            z-index: 2;
                            transition: all 0.4s ease;
                        }

                        .topic-icon svg {
                            transition: all 0.4s ease;
                            filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1));
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover .topic-icon svg {
                            transform: scale(1.2) rotate(8deg);
                            filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2));
                        }

                        /* Efeito de brilho nos cards */
                        .bordaIcone::after {
                            content: '';
                            position: absolute;
                            top: -50%;
                            left: -50%;
                            width: 200%;
                            height: 200%;
                            background: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 50%, transparent 70%);
                            transform: rotate(35deg);
                            transition: all 0.6s ease;
                            opacity: 0;
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover::after {
                            animation: shine 0.8s ease-out;
                        }

                        @keyframes shine {
                            0% {
                                opacity: 0;
                                transform: translateX(-100%) translateY(-100%) rotate(35deg);
                            }

                            50% {
                                opacity: 1;
                            }

                            100% {
                                opacity: 0;
                                transform: translateX(100%) translateY(100%) rotate(35deg);
                            }
                        }

                        .topic-title {
                            position: relative;
                            z-index: 2;
                            transition: all 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        .topic-title h6 {
                            font-weight: 600;
                            margin: 0;
                            transition: all 0.3s ease;
                            text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
                        }

                        .bordaIcone:hover .topic-title h6 {
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                            font-weight: 700;
                        }

                        /* ===== FLAG NOVO DISCRETA ===== */
                        .flag-novo {
                            position: absolute;
                            top: 12px;
                            /* right: 12px; */
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFCC00 0%, #f9a825 100%);
                            color: #006218;
                            /* padding: 3px 8px; */
                            border-radius: 12px;
                            font-size: 0.6rem;
                            font-weight: 600;
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                            z-index: 5;
                            box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.25);
                            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 98, 24, 0.1);
                            transition: all 0.3s ease;
                        }

                        .flag-novo:hover {
                            transform: scale(1.05);
                            box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.35);
                        }

                        /* ===== BOTÕES MELHORADOS ===== */
                        .btn-primary {
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color) 0%, var(--primary-dark) 100%);
                            border: none;
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius-sm);
                            font-weight: 600;
                            padding: 14px 28px;
                            transition: var(--transition);
                            text-transform: uppercase;
                            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                        }

                        .btn-primary:hover {
                            transform: translateY(-2px);
                            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 98, 24, 0.3);
                            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-dark) 0%, var(--primary-color) 100%);
                        }

                        /* ===== CARDS DE NOTÍCIAS APRIMORADOS ===== */
                        .card img {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius) var(--border-radius) 0 0;
                            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
                        }

                        .card:hover img {
                            transform: scale(1.05);
                        }

                        /* ===== MELHORIAS NOS VÍDEOS ===== */
                        .video-thumbnail {
                            border-radius: var(--border-radius);
                            overflow: hidden;
                            position: relative;
                            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
                            transition: var(--transition);
                        }

                        .video-thumbnail::before {
                            content: '';

                            }

                    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                        const scroller = document.querySelector('.video-scroller');
                        const btnLeft = document.querySelector('.video-scroll-left');
                        const btnRight = document.querySelector('.video-scroll-right');

                        function updateScrollButtons() {
                            if (!scroller) return;
                            btnLeft.style.display = scroller.scrollLeft > 10 ? 'block' : 'none';
                            btnRight.style.display = (scroller.scrollWidth - scroller.clientWidth - scroller.scrollLeft) > 10 ? 'block' : 'none';
                        }

                        if (scroller && btnLeft && btnRight) {
                            updateScrollButtons();
                            scroller.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollButtons);

                            btnLeft.addEventListener('click', function() {
                                scroller.scrollBy({
                                    left: -260,
                                    behavior: 'smooth'
                                });
                            });
                            btnRight.addEventListener('click', function() {
                                scroller.scrollBy({
                                    left: 260,
                                    behavior: 'smooth'
                                });
                            });

                            // Mostrar botões se houver overflow
                            setTimeout(updateScrollButtons, 300);
                            window.addEventListener('resize', updateScrollButtons);
                        }

                        // Efeito hover para play overlay
                        document.querySelectorAll('.video-card').forEach(function(card) {
                            card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
                                const overlay = card.querySelector('.video-play-overlay');
                                const playBtn = card.querySelector('.play-button-container');
                                if (overlay) overlay.style.opacity = '1';
                                if (playBtn) playBtn.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                            });
                            card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
                                const overlay = card.querySelector('.video-play-overlay');
                                const playBtn = card.querySelector('.play-button-container');
                                if (overlay) overlay.style.opacity = '0';
                                if (playBtn) playBtn.style.transform = 'scale(0.8)';
                            });
                        });
                    });
